name: pilotswarm-monorepo
description: Monorepo for pilotswarm SDK and CLI.

scripts.test:deploy-scripts: node --test --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning deploy/scripts/test/substitute-env.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/alias-map.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/all-mode.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/approve-pe.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/appgw-waf-rules.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/afd-mode-postdeploy.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/agent-pools-reconcile.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/common.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/deploy-cli.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/group-membership.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/git-cache-deploy.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/git-repo-worker-deploy.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/mcp-proxy-deploy.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/local-env.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/new-env.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/overlay-contracts.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/publish-manifests.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/services-manifest.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/bicep-outputs-cache.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/deploy-marker.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/dockerfile-lockfile.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/force-module.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/foundry-substitute.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/spc-keys-hash.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/render-params.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/stage-manifests.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/test-discovery.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/validate-foundry-deployments.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/seed-secrets.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/compose-env.test.mjs deploy/scripts/test/windows-worker-build.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm-horizon-store && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm-job-generator-provider && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm-job-generator && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm
scripts.test:agent-handoff: node --test scripts/test/native-delegation-*.test.mjs && npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm-horizon-store && npm run build:mcp --workspace=pilotswarm && npm run test:unit --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run test:local:agent-handoff --workspace=packages/sdk
scripts.test:native-delegation: node --test scripts/test/native-*.test.mjs packages/app/ui/core/test/native-task-*.test.mjs && npm exec --workspace=packages/sdk -- vitest run test/local/native-subagents.test.js test/local/native-subagents-runtime.test.js test/local/native-durable-filesystem.test.js test/local/native-task-observer.test.js test/local/native-task-observer-review.test.js test/local/system-agent-cron-contracts.test.js
scripts.job-generator: npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace=pilotswarm-job-generator && node --env-file=.env.remote packages/job-generator/dist/cli.js
scripts.test:feature-flags: npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run build:mcp --workspace=pilotswarm && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck packages/sdk/test/types/feature-flags.ts && npm exec --workspace=packages/sdk -- vitest run test/local/feature- test/local/native-subagents-runtime.test.js && node --test packages/app/ui/core/test/feature-flags-admin.test.mjs packages/app/mcp/test/unit/features.unit.mjs
